system.description:
At 3rd level, constant exposure to spiritual influence has made your own soul unusually difficult to disturb.
You gain a +2-class bonus to saving throws against possession, Soul Drain and effects with the Soul trait.
Furthermore, whenever you successfully resist possession, you immediately become aware that something attempted to enter or control you, even if the original effect would normally conceal that information.

Works automatically: the +2 class bonus is pre-ticked on saves against Soul-trait effects and offered against possession and Soul Drain.
